title: FDA slams GLP-1 compounder over risk of contaminating drugs ‘with filth’
snippet: FDA inspectors found evidence that the compounding pharmacy was making versions of Eli Lilly’s tirzepatide and Novo’s semaglutide “regularly or in inordinate amounts” at a site with “insanitary conditions.”

title: Integrative analysis of single-cell and bulk RNA sequencing reveals inflammatory mechanisms of cancer-induced nerve injury and enables prognostic modeling in lung adenocarcinoma.
snippet: Cancer-induced nerve injury (CINI) is implicated in unfavorable clinical outcomes across multiple cancer types. However, its biological role and prognostic value remain insufficiently characterized in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD).
